title: Field sprite characters
description: field/sprite_characters.yaml of the game pack: the characters some maps draw as sprites of their depth layers, drawn as their species' models with the 3D characters option (an engine improvement, docs/modulos/apps/game.md). Pixels are the map background's.

maps.description: The maps that draw it with these instances.

species.description: The species whose model stands in (its species folder's model).

sprites.description: The object instances that draw it; the first one's hidden flag decides whether the model shows.

shadow.description: The instance of its shadow, kept under the model; its middle is where the model stands.

feet.description: The background pixel under its feet (x, y), when no shadow gives it.

height.description: World units above the map's ground its feet stand on.

facing.description: The original Y rotation it faces (4096 a turn); the camera when left out.

look_at.description: The ground point (x, z) it faces, in the original's world units: where its drawing looks. A facing outweighs it.

animation.description: The original's animation id of the pose its drawing shows (a character lying on a rug); the idle clip when left out.

frame.description: The tick of its animation that its drawing holds: the model keeps that pose instead of playing the clip.

additive.description: Draws the model added to what is behind, its colours scaled by this, as a sprite drawn with the additive semi-transparency.
